name: exp_x2ma_digit_dm_361
summary: This EA uses a dual moving average (x2MA) crossover system with digital signal processing and a decision matrix (DM) to generate trend-following trade entries. It combines two smoothed moving averages to detect trend direction changes and applies a 3/6/1 decision logic to filter signals and manage positions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用双重移动平均线(x2MA)交叉系统，结合数字信号处理和决策矩阵(DM)来生成趋势跟踪交易信号。它通过两条平滑移动平均线检测趋势方向变化，并应用3/6/1决策逻辑来过滤信号和管理持仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双移动平均线交叉系统，通过数字信号处理方法对均线进行平滑处理以减少噪音信号。入场条件是当快线上穿慢线时做多，快线下穿慢线时做空，同时决策矩阵(361)会对信号进行多维度过滤确认。出场条件包括反向交叉信号平仓以及内置的止损和止盈机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态计算方式。资金管理方面提供了风险百分比参数控制每笔交易的最大风险敞口。决策矩阵的361逻辑可能代表3个确认条件、6个过滤维度和1个最终执行决策的层级化信号验证体系。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is built on a dual moving average crossover system enhanced with digital signal processing techniques to smooth the averages and reduce false signals. Entry conditions trigger a long position when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA, and a short position on the reverse cross, with the decision matrix (361) providing multi-dimensional signal filtration and confirmation. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse crossover signals as well as built-in stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms. Position sizing supports both fixed lot sizes and dynamic calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management incorporates a risk percentage parameter to control the maximum exposure per trade. The 361 decision matrix logic likely represents a hierarchical signal verification system with 3 confirmation conditions, 6 filtering dimensions, and 1 final execution decision, providing a structured approach to trade signal validation.

pros: 双均线交叉策略逻辑清晰，易于理解和验证
数字信号处理平滑技术有效减少虚假信号和频繁交易
决策矩阵(361)提供多层信号过滤，提高入场质量
参数化设计灵活，可适应不同品种和时间周期
内置止损止盈和风险百分比控制，具备基本风险管理框架
pros_en: Dual MA crossover logic is clear and easy to understand and verify
Digital signal processing smoothing effectively reduces false signals and over-trading
Decision matrix (361) provides multi-layer signal filtration for higher entry quality
Parameterized design is flexible and adaptable to different instruments and timeframes
Built-in stop-loss, take-profit, and risk percentage controls provide a basic risk management framework
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁亏损信号
缺乏市场状态识别机制，无法自动区分趋势和震荡行情
双均线系统存在固有滞后性，入场点位可能不够理想
决策矩阵逻辑可能过于僵化，缺乏自适应市场变化的动态调整
未明确包含点差过滤和滑点保护机制，在流动性差的市场中可能受损
cons_en: Trend-following strategy tends to generate frequent losing signals in ranging markets
Lacks market regime identification to automatically distinguish trending from ranging conditions
Dual MA system has inherent lag, leading to suboptimal entry points
Decision matrix logic may be too rigid without dynamic self-adaptation to changing market conditions
No explicit spread filter or slippage protection, vulnerable in low-liquidity markets
improvements: 增加市场状态识别模块（如ADX或波动率过滤器），在震荡行情中自动暂停交易或切换策略
引入自适应均线周期机制，根据市场波动率动态调整快慢均线参数以减少滞后性
improvements_en: Add a market regime identification module (e.g., ADX or volatility filter) to automatically pause trading or switch strategies during ranging conditions
Introduce adaptive MA period mechanism that dynamically adjusts fast/slow MA parameters based on market volatility to reduce lag

risk_points: 缺乏市场状态过滤，震荡行情中可能连续亏损
固定止损可能无法适应不同波动率环境，存在止损过近被扫或过远损失扩大的风险
risk_points_en: Lacks market regime filter, vulnerable to consecutive losses in ranging markets
Fixed stop-loss may not adapt to varying volatility environments, risking being stopped out too early or suffering excessive losses

It combines two smoothed moving averages to detect trend direction changes and applies a 3/6/1 decision logic to filter signals and manage positions.
